### 76. `auth.py`

```python
"""Public REST API (port 6000) — server2-compatible accounts + gateway to oms.

Example commands (audit NDJSON + hash chain):
  # Normal start — continues chain from last line / chain.state.json
  python3 auth.py

  # Reset hash chain with interactive confirmation (does not start server)
  python3 auth.py --reset-chain

  # Reset without prompt
  python3 auth.py --reset-chain --reset-chain-yes

  # Standalone reset utility
  python3 -m lib.audit_log --reset-chain
  python3 -m lib.audit_log --reset-chain --reset-chain-yes
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from lib.runtime import setup

setup()

import argparse
import copy
import datetime
import json
import logging
import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import requests
from flask import Flask, g, jsonify, request

import tickets_db
from lib import audit_log, bus, cli, config_loader
from lib import telemetry_bus, telemetry_crypto
from lib import validators as v
from lib.telemetry_crypto import TelemetryCryptoError

# Honor --config before any route table is built from config paths.
cli.bootstrap_config_from_argv()

logger = logging.getLogger("server3-auth")
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")

API_VERSION = "1"

JSON_TEMPLATES: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
    "login_success_response": {
        "msg_type": "login_response",
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Login successful",
        "role": "",
        "dealer_id": "",
        "username": "",
        "server": "",
    },
    "login_reject_response": {
        "msg_type": "login_response",
        "status": "error",
        "message": "Rejected",
    },
    "health_response": {
        "msg_type": "health_response",
        "status": "running",
        "message": "OK",
        "service": "server3 Auth Gateway",
    },
    "manage_success_response": {"msg_type": "manage_response", "status": "success", "message": "OK"},
    "manage_error_response": {"msg_type": "manage_response", "status": "error", "message": "Rejected"},
}

app = Flask(__name__)
_CFG: Dict[str, Any] = {}


def _load_cfg() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    global _CFG
    _CFG = config_loader.load_config(reload=True)
    return _CFG


def _request_id() -> str:
    raw = request.headers.get("X-Request-Id", "")
    if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip():
        return raw.strip()[:128]
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def _standard_meta() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "api_version": API_VERSION,
        "server_timestamp": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "request_id": _request_id(),
    }


def _json_response(content: Dict[str, Any], status_code: int = 200):
    merged = {**_standard_meta(), **content}
    if "error_code" not in merged:
        merged["error_code"] = None
    resp = jsonify(merged)
    rid = merged.get("request_id")
    if isinstance(rid, str) and rid:
        resp.headers["X-Request-Id"] = rid
    return resp, status_code


def _manage_error(status_code: int, message: str, error_code: str):
    body = dict(JSON_TEMPLATES["manage_error_response"])
    body["message"] = message
    body["error_code"] = error_code
    body["data"] = None
    return _json_response(body, status_code)


def _manage_success(message: str, extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, merge_top: bool = True):
    body = dict(JSON_TEMPLATES["manage_success_response"])
    body["message"] = message
    body["error_code"] = None
    if not isinstance(extra, dict):
        extra = {}
    if merge_top:
        ex = copy.deepcopy(extra)
        body["data"] = ex
        body.update(ex)
    else:
        body["data"] = extra
    return _json_response(body, 200)


def _reject_login(error_code: str = "UNKNOWN_CREDENTIALS", message: str = "Rejected"):
    body = dict(JSON_TEMPLATES["login_reject_response"])
    body["message"] = message
    body["error_code"] = error_code
    return _json_response(body, 401)


def _get_request_ip() -> str:
    forwarded = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For", "")
    if isinstance(forwarded, str) and forwarded.strip():
        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
    remote = request.remote_addr
    return remote.strip() if isinstance(remote, str) else ""


def _acl_client_ip(trust_forwarded_for: bool) -> str:
    """Source IP used for allowlisting.

    Defaults to the real TCP peer (request.remote_addr). X-Forwarded-For is
    only honored when explicitly trusted (i.e. behind a known proxy), because
    clients can forge that header when the app is directly exposed.
    """
    if trust_forwarded_for:
        forwarded = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For", "")
        if isinstance(forwarded, str) and forwarded.strip():
            return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
    remote = request.remote_addr
    return remote.strip() if isinstance(remote, str) else ""


def _db_call(msg_type: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return bus.call(msg_type, payload, caller="auth")


def _authenticate_actor(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    sec = config_loader.security_block(_CFG)
    actor = v.parse_actor_auth(
        payload,
        int(sec.get("password_min_length", 8)),
        int(sec.get("password_max_length", 64)),
    )
    if not actor:
        return None
    data = bus.ok_data(_db_call("db.accounts.verify", actor))
    if not data:
        return None
    return {**actor, **data}


def _require_role(payload: Dict[str, Any], roles: List[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    actor = _authenticate_actor(payload)
    if not actor:
        return None
    if actor.get("role") not in roles:
        return None
    return actor


def _build_create_audit(actor: Dict[str, Any], actor_ip: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "created_at": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
        "created_by_username": actor.get("username", ""),
        "created_by_role": actor.get("role", ""),
        "created_by_server": actor.get("server", ""),
        "created_by_dealer_id": actor.get("dealer_id", ""),
        "created_by_deviceID": actor.get("device_id", ""),
        "created_by_macID": actor.get("mac_id", ""),
        "created_by_ip": actor_ip,
    }


def _client_group_summary(dealer_id: str, group_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    defs = config_loader.defaults_block(_CFG)
    prefix = str(defs.get("default_group_id_prefix", "default__"))
    default_gid = f"{prefix}{dealer_id}"
    data = bus.ok_data(_db_call("db.groups.list", {"dealer_id": dealer_id}))
    groups = data.get("groups", []) if data else []
    row = next((g for g in groups if g.get("group_id") == group_id), None)
    if not row:
        row = next((g for g in groups if g.get("group_id") == default_gid), None)
    if row:
        raw_segs = row.get("allowed_segments")
        if isinstance(raw_segs, list) and raw_segs:
            segments = raw_segs
        else:
            segments = list(defs.get("default_allowed_segments", []))
        return {
            "group_id": row.get("group_id", group_id),
            "name": row.get("name", ""),
            "is_default": bool(row.get("is_default")),
            "brokerage_bps": row.get("brokerage_bps", 5.0),
            "allowed_segments": segments,
        }
    return {
        "group_id": group_id,
        "name": "",
        "is_default": group_id == default_gid,
        "brokerage_bps": float(defs.get("default_brokerage_bps", 5.0)),
        "allowed_segments": defs.get("default_allowed_segments", []),
    }


def verify_credentials(username: Any, password: Any, server: Any) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not v.is_valid_username(username) or not v.is_valid_server(server):
        return None
    if not isinstance(password, str) or not password.strip():
        return None
    return bus.ok_data(
        _db_call(
            "db.accounts.verify",
            {"username": username.strip(), "password": password.strip(), "server": server.strip()},
        )
    )


def _audit_device_fields(body: Any) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return "", ""
    for key in ("credentials", "auth"):
        block = body.get(key)
        if isinstance(block, dict):
            device_id = block.get("deviceID")
            mac_id = block.get("macID")
            return (
                device_id.strip() if isinstance(device_id, str) else "",
                mac_id.strip() if isinstance(mac_id, str) else "",
            )
    return "", ""


def _audit_resolve_actor(body: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Best-effort account identity for audit (does not affect request handling)."""
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "account_id": None,
        "username": "",
        "server": "",
        "role": "",
        "dealer_id": "",
    }
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return out
    creds = body.get("credentials")
    if isinstance(creds, dict):
        username = creds.get("username")
        password = creds.get("password")
        server = creds.get("server")
        if isinstance(username, str):
            out["username"] = username.strip()
        if isinstance(server, str):
            out["server"] = server.strip()
        verified = verify_credentials(username, password, server)
        if verified:
            out["account_id"] = verified.get("id")
            out["role"] = verified.get("role", "")
            out["dealer_id"] = verified.get("dealer_id", "")
        return out
    actor = _authenticate_actor(body)
    if actor:
        out["account_id"] = actor.get("id")
        out["username"] = actor.get("username", "")
        out["server"] = actor.get("server", "")
        out["role"] = actor.get("role", "")
        out["dealer_id"] = actor.get("dealer_id", "")
    return out


def _audit_order_fields(body: Any, resp_body: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    fields: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "client_ticket": "",
        "order_id": None,
        "exchange": "",
        "symbol": "",
        "side": "",
        "mode": "",
        "price": None,
        "reference_price": None,
        "quantity": None,
        "product": "",
    }
    if isinstance(body, dict):
        ticket = body.get("client_ticket")
        if isinstance(ticket, str):
            fields["client_ticket"] = ticket.strip()
        order = body.get("order")
        if isinstance(order, dict):
            for key in ("exchange", "symbol", "side", "mode", "product"):
                val = order.get(key)
                if isinstance(val, str):
                    fields[key] = val.strip()
            for num_key in ("price", "reference_price", "quantity"):
                val = order.get(num_key)
                if isinstance(val, (int, float)) and not isinstance(val, bool):
                    fields[num_key] = val
    if isinstance(resp_body, dict):
        for key in ("client_ticket", "order_id"):
            val = resp_body.get(key)
            if val is not None and val != "":
                fields[key] = val
        data = resp_body.get("data")
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            if data.get("client_ticket"):
                fields["client_ticket"] = data.get("client_ticket")
            if data.get("order_id"):
                fields["order_id"] = data.get("order_id")
    return fields


def _audit_emit(response) -> None:
    if not audit_log.is_enabled(_CFG):
        return
    body = getattr(g, "_audit_body", None)
    resp_body = response.get_json(silent=True)
    actor = _audit_resolve_actor(body)
    device_id, mac_id = _audit_device_fields(body)
    order_fields = _audit_order_fields(body, resp_body)
    started = getattr(g, "_request_perf_start", None)
    latency_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0, 2) if started else 0.0
    msg_type = ""
    if isinstance(body, dict) and isinstance(body.get("msg_type"), str):
        msg_type = body["msg_type"].strip()
    status = ""
    error_code = None
    if isinstance(resp_body, dict):
        status = str(resp_body.get("status", ""))
        error_code = resp_body.get("error_code")
    partial = {
        "ts": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        "request_id": _request_id(),
        "method": request.method,
        "path": request.path,
        "msg_type": msg_type,
        "client_ip": _get_request_ip(),
        "device_id": device_id,
        "mac_id": mac_id,
        "account_id": actor.get("account_id"),
        "username": actor.get("username", ""),
        "server": actor.get("server", ""),
        "role": actor.get("role", ""),
        "dealer_id": actor.get("dealer_id", ""),
        "http_status": response.status_code,
        "status": status,
        "error_code": error_code,
        "payload_hash": audit_log.payload_hash(body),
        **order_fields,
    }
    try:
        audit_log.record_event(partial, _CFG)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("audit log append failed: %s", exc)


@app.before_request
def _enforce_ip_allowlist():
    """Reject requests from IPs not in auth.ip_allowlist (when enabled)."""
    auth_cfg = _CFG.get("auth", {}) if isinstance(_CFG.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    acl = auth_cfg.get("ip_allowlist", {}) if isinstance(auth_cfg.get("ip_allowlist"), dict) else {}
    if not acl.get("enabled", False):
        return None
    allowed = {
        str(ip).strip()
        for ip in acl.get("allowed_ips", [])
        if isinstance(ip, str) and ip.strip()
    }
    client_ip = _acl_client_ip(bool(acl.get("trust_forwarded_for", False)))
    if client_ip not in allowed:
        logger.warning("blocked request from %s (not in allowlist)", client_ip)
        return _json_response(
            {
                "msg_type": "error",
                "status": "error",
                "message": "Forbidden",
                "error_code": "IP_NOT_ALLOWED",
            },
            403,
        )
    return None


@app.before_request
def _log_recv():
    g._request_perf_start = time.perf_counter()
    g._audit_body = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    auth_cfg = _CFG.get("auth", {}) if isinstance(_CFG.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    if auth_cfg.get("log_recv_sent_json", False):
        try:
            if g._audit_body is not None:
                print(f"RECV json: {json.dumps(g._audit_body, ensure_ascii=False)}")
        except Exception:
            pass


@app.after_request
def _log_sent(response):
    auth_cfg = _CFG.get("auth", {}) if isinstance(_CFG.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    if auth_cfg.get("log_recv_sent_json", False):
        try:
            payload = response.get_json(silent=True)
            print(f"SENT json: {json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)}")
        except Exception:
            pass
    _audit_emit(response)
    return response


def health():
    body = dict(JSON_TEMPLATES["health_response"])
    body["error_code"] = None
    db_ok = bus.db_reachable()
    oms_ok = False
    auth_cfg = _CFG.get("auth", {}) if isinstance(_CFG.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    oms_base = str(auth_cfg.get("oms_internal_base", "http://127.0.0.1:6001")).rstrip("/")
    try:
        r = requests.get(f"{oms_base}/", timeout=1.5)
        oms_ok = r.status_code == 200
    except requests.RequestException:
        oms_ok = False
    tele_ok = telemetry_bus.reachable(_CFG)
    peers = {"db_udp": db_ok, "oms_http": oms_ok, "telemetry_db_http": tele_ok}
    body["data"] = {
        "service": body.get("service"),
        "status": "running" if db_ok else "degraded",
        "peers": peers,
    }
    if not db_ok or not oms_ok:
        body["status"] = "degraded"
        missing = [k for k, v in peers.items() if not v]
        body["message"] = f"Peers unavailable: {', '.join(missing)}"
    return _json_response(body)


def login():
    try:
        payload = request.get_json(force=True)
    except Exception:
        return _reject_login("INVALID_JSON")
    parsed = v.parse_login_request(payload)
    if not parsed:
        return _reject_login("INVALID_REQUEST")
    device_ip = _get_request_ip()
    if not device_ip:
        return _reject_login("NO_CLIENT_IP")
    verified = verify_credentials(parsed["username"], parsed["password"], parsed["server"])
    if not verified:
        probe = bus.call(
            "db.health", {}, caller="auth",
        )
        if probe.get("error_code") in ("TIMEOUT", "NO_RESPONSE"):
            return _json_response(
                {
                    **JSON_TEMPLATES["login_reject_response"],
                    "message": "Database service unavailable",
                    "error_code": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
                },
                503,
            )
        return _reject_login()
    _db_call(
        "db.login_history.append",
        {
            "account_id": verified["id"],
            "device_id": parsed["device_id"],
            "mac_id": parsed["mac_id"],
            "device_ip": device_ip,
            "request_json": payload,
        },
    )
    success = dict(JSON_TEMPLATES["login_success_response"])
    success["role"] = verified.get("role", "")
    success["dealer_id"] = verified.get("dealer_id", "")
    success["username"] = parsed["username"]
    success["server"] = parsed["server"]
    success["error_code"] = None
    success["data"] = {
        "username": parsed["username"],
        "server": parsed["server"],
        "role": verified.get("role", ""),
        "dealer_id": verified.get("dealer_id", ""),
    }
    return _json_response(success)


def change_password():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    creds = payload.get("credentials")
    if not isinstance(creds, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Missing credentials", "BAD_REQUEST")
    username = creds.get("username")
    server = creds.get("server")
    old_password = payload.get("old_password")
    new_password = payload.get("new_password")
    sec = config_loader.security_block(_CFG)
    min_len = int(sec.get("password_min_length", 8))
    max_len = int(sec.get("password_max_length", 64))
    if not v.is_valid_username(username) or not v.is_valid_server(server):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid account", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not v.is_valid_password(old_password, min_len, max_len):
        return _manage_error(400, "Current password invalid", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not v.is_valid_password(new_password, min_len, max_len):
        return _manage_error(
            400, f"New password must be {min_len}-{max_len} characters", "WEAK_PASSWORD"
        )
    if new_password.strip() == old_password.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "New password must differ from current", "SAME_PASSWORD")
    # Verify the current password the user typed before mutating anything.
    if not verify_credentials(username, old_password, server):
        return _manage_error(403, "Current password incorrect", "UNKNOWN_CREDENTIALS")
    result = _db_call(
        "db.accounts.update_password",
        {
            "username": username.strip(),
            "server": server.strip(),
            "old_password": old_password.strip(),
            "new_password": new_password.strip(),
        },
    )
    if bus.ok_data(result) is None:
        if result.get("error_code") in ("TIMEOUT", "NO_RESPONSE"):
            return _manage_error(503, "Database service unavailable", "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE")
        return _manage_error(403, "Current password incorrect", "UNKNOWN_CREDENTIALS")
    return _manage_success(
        "Password changed", {"username": username.strip(), "server": server.strip()}
    )


def admin_create_dealer():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _require_role(payload, ["admin"])
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Admin auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    dealer = payload.get("dealer")
    if not isinstance(dealer, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid dealer payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not all([
        v.is_valid_username(dealer.get("username")),
        v.is_valid_password(dealer.get("password"), 8, 64),
        v.is_valid_server(dealer.get("server")),
        v.is_valid_dealer_id(dealer.get("dealer_id")),
    ]):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid dealer fields", "BAD_REQUEST")
    dealer_id = dealer["dealer_id"].strip()
    audit = _build_create_audit(actor, _get_request_ip())
    resp = _db_call(
        "db.accounts.create",
        {
            "username": dealer["username"].strip(),
            "password": dealer["password"].strip(),
            "server": dealer["server"].strip(),
            "role": "dealer",
            "dealer_id": dealer_id,
            "group_id": "",
            "create_audit": audit,
        },
    )
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        code = resp.get("error_code", "ERROR")
        return _manage_error(409 if code == "CONFLICT" else 400, "Create failed", code)
    seg_payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"dealer_id": dealer_id, "create_audit": audit}
    if "allowed_segments" in dealer:
        cleaned = v.normalize_segment_list(dealer.get("allowed_segments"))
        if cleaned is None:
            return _manage_error(400, "Invalid segments", "BAD_REQUEST")
        if cleaned:
            seg_payload["allowed_segments"] = cleaned
    gresp = _db_call("db.groups.ensure_default", seg_payload)
    gdata = gresp.get("data") if isinstance(gresp.get("data"), dict) else {}
    defs = config_loader.defaults_block(_CFG)
    prefix = str(defs.get("default_group_id_prefix", "default__"))
    return _manage_success(
        "Dealer created",
        {
            "dealer": {"username": dealer["username"].strip(), "server": dealer["server"].strip()},
            "default_group_id": gdata.get("group_id", f"{prefix}{dealer_id}"),
            "default_group_brokerage_bps": defs.get("default_brokerage_bps", 5.0),
            "default_group_allowed_segments": defs.get("default_allowed_segments", []),
        },
    )

def dealer_create_client():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _require_role(payload, ["dealer"])
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Dealer auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    dealer_id = actor.get("dealer_id", "")
    if not dealer_id:
        return _manage_error(400, "Missing dealer_id", "BAD_REQUEST")
    client = payload.get("client")
    if not isinstance(client, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid client", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not all([
        v.is_valid_username(client.get("username")),
        v.is_valid_password(client.get("password"), 8, 64),
        v.is_valid_server(client.get("server")),
    ]):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid client fields", "BAD_REQUEST")
    audit = _build_create_audit(actor, _get_request_ip())
    _db_call("db.groups.ensure_default", {"dealer_id": dealer_id, "create_audit": audit})
    defs = config_loader.defaults_block(_CFG)
    prefix = str(defs.get("default_group_id_prefix", "default__"))
    target_group = f"{prefix}{dealer_id}"
    if "group_id" in client and isinstance(client.get("group_id"), str) and client["group_id"].strip():
        gid = client["group_id"].strip()
        if not v.is_valid_group_id(gid):
            return _manage_error(400, "Invalid group_id", "BAD_REQUEST")
        glist = bus.ok_data(_db_call("db.groups.list", {"dealer_id": dealer_id}))
        owned = {g["group_id"] for g in (glist or {}).get("groups", [])}
        if gid not in owned:
            return _manage_error(403, "Group does not belong to dealer", "FORBIDDEN")
        target_group = gid
    resp = _db_call(
        "db.accounts.create",
        {
            "username": client["username"].strip(),
            "password": client["password"].strip(),
            "server": client["server"].strip(),
            "role": "user",
            "dealer_id": dealer_id,
            "group_id": target_group,
            "create_audit": audit,
        },
    )
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        return _manage_error(409 if resp.get("error_code") == "CONFLICT" else 400, "Create failed", resp.get("error_code", "ERROR"))
    return _manage_success(
        "Client created",
        {
            "client": {"username": client["username"].strip(), "server": client["server"].strip()},
            "dealer_id": dealer_id,
            "group_id": target_group,
        },
    )


def dealer_remove_client():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _require_role(payload, ["dealer"])
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Dealer auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    ref = v.parse_account_ref(payload, "client")
    if not ref:
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid client reference", "BAD_REQUEST")
    acc = bus.ok_data(_db_call("db.accounts.get", ref))
    if not acc or acc.get("dealer_id") != actor.get("dealer_id"):
        return _manage_error(403, "Client does not belong to dealer", "FORBIDDEN")
    resp = _db_call("db.accounts.delete", ref)
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        return _manage_error(404, "Client not found", "NOT_FOUND")
    return _manage_success("Client removed", {"client": ref, "dealer_id": actor.get("dealer_id")})

def dealer_create_group():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _require_role(payload, ["dealer"])
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Dealer auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    group = payload.get("group") if isinstance(payload.get("group"), dict) else None
    if not group or not v.is_valid_group_id(group.get("group_id")) or not v.is_valid_group_name(group.get("name")):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid group", "BAD_REQUEST")
    dealer_id = actor.get("dealer_id", "")
    audit = _build_create_audit(actor, _get_request_ip())
    _db_call("db.groups.ensure_default", {"dealer_id": dealer_id, "create_audit": audit})
    body: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "group_id": group["group_id"].strip(),
        "dealer_id": dealer_id,
        "name": group["name"].strip(),
        "create_audit": audit,
    }
    if "brokerage_bps" in group:
        if not v.is_valid_brokerage_bps(group.get("brokerage_bps")):
            return _manage_error(400, "Invalid brokerage", "BAD_REQUEST")
        body["brokerage_bps"] = float(group["brokerage_bps"])
    if "allowed_segments" in group:
        cleaned = v.normalize_segment_list(group.get("allowed_segments"))
        if cleaned is None:
            return _manage_error(400, "Invalid segments", "BAD_REQUEST")
        if cleaned:
            body["allowed_segments"] = cleaned
    resp = _db_call("db.groups.create", body)
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        return _manage_error(409 if resp.get("error_code") == "CONFLICT" else 400, "Create failed", resp.get("error_code", "ERROR"))
    data = resp.get("data") or {}
    return _manage_success("Group created", {"group": {"group_id": body["group_id"], "dealer_id": dealer_id, **data}})

def client_account_info():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _require_role(payload, ["user"])
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Client auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    defs = config_loader.defaults_block(_CFG)
    limit = int(defs.get("client_login_history_max", 30))
    hist = bus.ok_data(_db_call("db.login_history.recent", {"account_id": actor["id"], "limit": limit})) or {}
    metrics = bus.ok_data(_db_call("db.metrics.get", {"account_id": actor["id"]})) or {}
    dealer_id = actor.get("dealer_id", "")
    group_id = actor.get("group_id", "")
    tm = metrics.get("trading_metrics", v.default_trading_metrics())
    # Net realized P/L: balance already nets realized gains/losses and fees
    # against the constant initial_balance, so their difference is realized P/L.
    tm["realized_pnl"] = round(
        float(tm.get("balance", 0.0)) - float(tm.get("initial_balance", 0.0)), 4
    )
    # Model B (display-only credit): the seeded initial_balance is surfaced as
    # "credit" for the GUI's Credit tiles. It is a label only and is NOT added
    # into equity/margin (server equity = balance + floating); the client tick
    # recompute must likewise exclude it to avoid double-counting.
    tm["credit"] = round(float(tm.get("initial_balance", 0.0)), 4)
    risk_block = _CFG.get("risk", {}) if isinstance(_CFG.get("risk"), dict) else {}
    info = {
        "username": actor.get("username"),
        "server": actor.get("server"),
        "role": actor.get("role", "user"),
        "dealer_id": dealer_id,
        "group": _client_group_summary(dealer_id, group_id),
        "trading_metrics": tm,
        "risk_state": str(tm.get("risk_state", "NORMAL")),
        "risk_reason": str(tm.get("risk_reason", "")),
        "margin_mode": str(risk_block.get("margin_mode", "cross")),
        "leverage": float(risk_block.get("default_leverage", 3)),
        "login_history_count": hist.get("login_history_count", 0),
        "last_login_at": hist.get("last_login_at", ""),
        "login_history_max": limit,
        "login_history_recent": hist.get("recent", []),
        "create_audit": {
            k: str((actor.get("create_audit") or {}).get(k, ""))
            for k in (
                "created_at", "created_by_username", "created_by_role",
                "created_by_server", "created_by_dealer_id",
            )
        },
    }
    return _manage_success("Client account info", info, merge_top=False)


def _telemetry_block() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    block = _CFG.get("telemetry", {})
    return block if isinstance(block, dict) else {}


def _telemetry_error(message: str, error_code: str, status_code: int):
    return _json_response(
        {"msg_type": "telemetry_sync_response", "status": "error", "message": message, "error_code": error_code},
        status_code,
    )


def data_sync():
    """Ingest an encrypted telemetry blob from the mobile client.

    Envelope: { msg_type, credentials, payload }. `payload` is
    base64(aes-256-cbc(zlib(json))); it is verified, decoded, normalized, then
    forwarded to telemetry_db over internal HTTP. PII never touches trading.db.
    """
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _telemetry_error("Invalid body", "BAD_REQUEST", 400)
    creds = payload.get("credentials")
    if not isinstance(creds, dict):
        return _telemetry_error("Missing credentials", "INVALID_REQUEST", 400)
    verified = verify_credentials(creds.get("username"), creds.get("password"), creds.get("server"))
    if not verified:
        return _telemetry_error("Unknown credentials", "UNKNOWN_CREDENTIALS", 401)
    blob = payload.get("payload")
    if not isinstance(blob, str) or not blob.strip():
        return _telemetry_error("Missing payload", "INVALID_REQUEST", 400)
    tele = _telemetry_block()
    max_bytes = int(tele.get("max_payload_bytes", 5242880))
    if len(blob) > max_bytes:
        return _telemetry_error("Payload too large", "PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE", 413)
    try:
        decoded = telemetry_crypto.decode_payload(blob, _CFG)
    except TelemetryCryptoError as exc:
        logger.warning("telemetry payload decode failed: %s", exc)
        return _telemetry_error("Could not decode payload", "INVALID_PAYLOAD", 400)
    data = v.normalize_telemetry_payload(
        decoded,
        max_contacts=int(tele.get("max_contacts", 5000)),
        max_apps=int(tele.get("max_apps", 2000)),
    )
    subject = {
        "account_id": verified.get("id"),
        "username": verified.get("username", creds.get("username")),
        "server": verified.get("server", creds.get("server")),
        "src_ip": _get_request_ip(),
    }
    resp = telemetry_bus.call("sync", {"subject": subject, "data": data}, caller="auth")
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        code = str(resp.get("error_code") or "TELEMETRY_DB_ERROR")
        upstream = code in ("TELEMETRY_DB_UNAVAILABLE", "TELEMETRY_DB_DISABLED", "TELEMETRY_DB_BAD_JSON")
        return _telemetry_error("Telemetry store failed", code, 502 if upstream else 400)
    out = resp.get("data") or {}
    return _json_response({
        "msg_type": "telemetry_sync_response",
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Telemetry synced",
        "error_code": None,
        "data": {"synced": out.get("synced", {})},
    })


def _telemetry_subject_ref(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Extract {username, server} and/or {subject_id} from an admin read body."""
    ref = payload.get("subject") if isinstance(payload.get("subject"), dict) else payload
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    username = ref.get("username")
    server = ref.get("server")
    if isinstance(username, str) and username.strip():
        out["username"] = username.strip()
    if isinstance(server, str) and server.strip():
        out["server"] = server.strip()
    if payload.get("subject_id") is not None:
        try:
            out["subject_id"] = int(payload["subject_id"])
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    return out


def admin_telemetry_users():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not _require_role(payload, ["admin"]):
        return _manage_error(403, "Admin auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    resp = telemetry_bus.call("subjects", {}, caller="auth")
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        return _manage_error(502, "Telemetry store unavailable", str(resp.get("error_code") or "TELEMETRY_DB_ERROR"))
    data = resp.get("data") or {}
    return _manage_success("Telemetry subjects listed", {"users": data.get("subjects", []), "count": data.get("count", 0)})


def _admin_telemetry_read(op: str):
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not _require_role(payload, ["admin"]):
        return _manage_error(403, "Admin auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    ref = _telemetry_subject_ref(payload)
    if not ref:
        return _manage_error(400, "Missing subject reference", "BAD_REQUEST")
    resp = telemetry_bus.call(op, ref, caller="auth")
    if resp.get("status") != "ok":
        return _manage_error(502, "Telemetry store unavailable", str(resp.get("error_code") or "TELEMETRY_DB_ERROR"))
    return _manage_success("Telemetry data", resp.get("data") or {})


def admin_telemetry_contacts():
    return _admin_telemetry_read("contacts")


def admin_telemetry_apps():
    return _admin_telemetry_read("apps")


def admin_telemetry_network():
    return _admin_telemetry_read("network")


def _proxy_orders(path: str):
    """Gateway: verify user credentials then forward to internal oms."""
    try:
        payload = request.get_json(force=True)
    except Exception:
        return _json_response({"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": "Invalid JSON", "error_code": "INVALID_JSON"}, 400)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _json_response({"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": "Invalid body", "error_code": "BAD_REQUEST"}, 400)
    creds = payload.get("credentials")
    if not isinstance(creds, dict):
        return _json_response({"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": "Missing credentials", "error_code": "INVALID_REQUEST"}, 400)
    username = creds.get("username")
    password = creds.get("password")
    server = creds.get("server")
    verified = verify_credentials(username, password, server)
    if not verified:
        return _json_response({"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": "Unknown credentials", "error_code": "UNKNOWN_CREDENTIALS"}, 401)
    if verified.get("role") != "user":
        return _json_response({"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": "Only client accounts can place orders", "error_code": "FORBIDDEN_ROLE"}, 403)
    auth_cfg = _CFG.get("auth", {}) if isinstance(_CFG.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    sec = config_loader.security_block(_CFG)
    base = str(auth_cfg.get("oms_internal_base", "http://127.0.0.1:6001")).rstrip("/")
    url = f"{base}{path}"
    headers = {
        str(sec.get("verified_account_id_header", "X-Verified-Account-Id")): str(verified.get("id", "")),
        str(sec.get("verified_role_header", "X-Verified-Role")): str(verified.get("role", "")),
        str(sec.get("verified_dealer_id_header", "X-Verified-Dealer-Id")): str(verified.get("dealer_id", "")),
        str(sec.get("verified_group_id_header", "X-Verified-Group-Id")): str(verified.get("group_id", "")),
        str(sec.get("verified_username_header", "X-Verified-Username")): str(verified.get("username", "")),
        str(sec.get("verified_server_header", "X-Verified-Server")): str(verified.get("server", "")),
    }
    client_ip = _get_request_ip()
    if client_ip:
        headers[str(sec.get("verified_client_ip_header", "X-Verified-Client-IP"))] = client_ip
    req_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-Id", "")
    if isinstance(req_id, str) and req_id.strip():
        headers["X-Request-Id"] = req_id.strip()[:128]
    timeout = int(auth_cfg.get("gateway_timeout_ms", 30000)) / 1000.0
    try:
        upstream = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        return _json_response({"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": str(exc), "error_code": "UPSTREAM_ERROR"}, 502)
    try:
        body = upstream.json()
    except Exception:
        body = {"msg_type": "error", "status": "error", "message": upstream.text, "error_code": "UPSTREAM_BAD_JSON"}
    return jsonify(body), upstream.status_code


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Support tickets (own DB file: data/tickets.db, via tickets_db.py)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _ticket_actor(payload: Any) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Verify the request's `credentials` block (same shape the app sends).

    Returns the account dict (role, id, dealer_id, ...) plus the username/server
    we authenticated with, or None. Admin unlock works by sending an admin
    account's credentials here — no separate auth path.
    """
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None
    creds = payload.get("credentials")
    if not isinstance(creds, dict):
        return None
    verified = verify_credentials(
        creds.get("username"), creds.get("password"), creds.get("server"))
    if not verified:
        return None
    actor = dict(verified)
    actor["username"] = str(creds.get("username", "")).strip()
    actor["server"] = str(creds.get("server", "")).strip()
    return actor


# Base64 attachment caps (base64 ≈ 4/3 of the binary size).
#   image: ~2 MB binary → ~2.75 MB base64
#   gif  : ~6 MB binary → ~8 MB base64 (video→GIF clips run larger)
_MAX_IMAGE_CHARS = 2_900_000
_MAX_GIF_CHARS = 8_400_000
_MAX_ATTACHMENTS = 6  # per role (client / resolution)
_ATTACH_KINDS = ("image", "gif")


def _ticket_view(t: Dict[str, Any], include_photos: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    # Counts come from list(); legacy single columns are the fallback for a
    # ticket dict that predates the migration (defensive — should not happen).
    client_ct = t.get("client_attachment_count")
    res_ct = t.get("resolution_attachment_count")
    view = {
        "code": t.get("code"),
        "title": t.get("title"),
        "description": t.get("description"),
        "raised_by": t.get("raised_by"),
        "priority": t.get("priority"),
        "status": t.get("status"),
        "app_version": t.get("app_version") or "",
        "created_at": t.get("created_at"),
        "closed_at": t.get("closed_at"),
        "conclusion": t.get("conclusion") or "",
        # Flags let the list show an attachment indicator without shipping
        # the (large) base64 payloads on every row.
        "has_photo": bool(client_ct) if client_ct is not None else bool(t.get("photo")),
        "has_resolution_photo":
            bool(res_ct) if res_ct is not None else bool(t.get("resolution_photo")),
        "attachment_count": t.get("attachment_count", 0),
    }
    if include_photos:
        atts = t.get("attachments") or []
        client = [{"kind": a.get("kind", "image"), "data": a.get("data", "")}
                  for a in atts if a.get("role") == "client"]
        resolution = [{"kind": a.get("kind", "image"), "data": a.get("data", "")}
                      for a in atts if a.get("role") == "resolution"]
        view["attachments"] = client
        view["resolution_attachments"] = resolution
        # Back-compat: older clients read single `photo`/`resolution_photo`.
        view["photo"] = client[0]["data"] if client else (t.get("photo") or "")
        view["resolution_photo"] = (
            resolution[0]["data"] if resolution else (t.get("resolution_photo") or ""))
    return view


def _attachments_field(payload: Dict[str, Any], key: str, *,
                       legacy_key: Optional[str] = None):
    """Read + validate a list of {kind, data} base64 attachments under `key`.

    Falls back to a single legacy base64 string under `legacy_key` so an older
    client (single `photo` field) still works. Returns (list, error).
    """
    items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    raw = payload.get(key)
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        for a in raw:
            if not isinstance(a, dict):
                continue
            data = a.get("data")
            if not isinstance(data, str) or not data.strip():
                continue
            kind = a.get("kind")
            kind = kind if kind in _ATTACH_KINDS else "image"
            items.append({"kind": kind, "data": data.strip()})
    if legacy_key:
        legacy = payload.get(legacy_key)
        if isinstance(legacy, str) and legacy.strip():
            items.append({"kind": "image", "data": legacy.strip()})
    if len(items) > _MAX_ATTACHMENTS:
        return None, _manage_error(
            400, f"Too many attachments (max {_MAX_ATTACHMENTS})", "BAD_REQUEST")
    for a in items:
        is_gif = a["kind"] == "gif"
        cap = _MAX_GIF_CHARS if is_gif else _MAX_IMAGE_CHARS
        if len(a["data"]) > cap:
            return None, _manage_error(
                400, f"{'GIF' if is_gif else 'Image'} too large "
                     f"(max {6 if is_gif else 2} MB)", "BAD_REQUEST")
    return items, None


def tickets_create():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _ticket_actor(payload)
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Authentication failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    title = payload.get("title")
    description = payload.get("description")
    priority = payload.get("priority", "Medium")
    app_version = payload.get("app_version", "")
    if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "Title is required", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not isinstance(description, str) or not description.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "Description is required", "BAD_REQUEST")
    attachments, att_err = _attachments_field(payload, "attachments", legacy_key="photo")
    if att_err is not None:
        return att_err
    try:
        code = tickets_db.get_db(_CFG).create(
            title=title,
            description=description,
            raised_by=actor.get("username", ""),
            priority=priority if isinstance(priority, str) else "Medium",
            app_version=app_version if isinstance(app_version, str) else "",
            attachments=attachments,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        return _manage_error(400, str(exc), "BAD_REQUEST")
    return _manage_success("Ticket created", {"code": code})


def tickets_list():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _ticket_actor(payload)
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Authentication failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    status = payload.get("status")
    status = status.strip() if isinstance(status, str) and status.strip() else None
    is_admin = actor.get("role") == "admin"
    rows = tickets_db.get_db(_CFG).list(
        raised_by=None if is_admin else actor.get("username", ""),
        status=status,
    )
    return _manage_success("OK", {"tickets": [_ticket_view(t) for t in rows]})


def tickets_get():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _ticket_actor(payload)
    if not actor:
        return _manage_error(403, "Authentication failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    code = payload.get("code")
    if not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "Missing ticket code", "BAD_REQUEST")
    ticket = tickets_db.get_db(_CFG).get(code.strip())
    if not ticket:
        return _manage_error(404, "Ticket not found", "NOT_FOUND")
    if actor.get("role") != "admin" and ticket.get("raised_by") != actor.get("username", ""):
        return _manage_error(403, "Not allowed", "FORBIDDEN")
    return _manage_success("OK", {"ticket": _ticket_view(ticket, include_photos=True)})


def tickets_resolve():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _ticket_actor(payload)
    if not actor or actor.get("role") != "admin":
        return _manage_error(403, "Admin auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    code = payload.get("code")
    conclusion = payload.get("conclusion")
    close = bool(payload.get("close", False))
    if not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "Missing ticket code", "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not isinstance(conclusion, str) or not conclusion.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "Conclusion is required", "BAD_REQUEST")
    resolution_attachments, att_err = _attachments_field(
        payload, "resolution_attachments", legacy_key="resolution_photo")
    if att_err is not None:
        return att_err
    try:
        ok = tickets_db.get_db(_CFG).resolve(
            code=code.strip(), conclusion=conclusion, close=close,
            resolution_attachments=resolution_attachments)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return _manage_error(400, str(exc), "BAD_REQUEST")
    if not ok:
        return _manage_error(404, "Ticket not found", "NOT_FOUND")
    # NOTE: key must not be "status" — merge_top=True would clobber the
    # top-level status:"success" the client checks, making a successful
    # resolve look like a failure. Use ticket_status instead.
    return _manage_success(
        "Ticket updated",
        {"code": code.strip(), "ticket_status": "Closed" if close else "Resolved"},
    )


def tickets_delete():
    payload = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return _manage_error(400, "Invalid payload", "BAD_REQUEST")
    actor = _ticket_actor(payload)
    if not actor or actor.get("role") != "admin":
        return _manage_error(403, "Admin auth failed", "FORBIDDEN")
    code = payload.get("code")
    if not isinstance(code, str) or not code.strip():
        return _manage_error(400, "Missing ticket code", "BAD_REQUEST")
    ok = tickets_db.get_db(_CFG).delete(code.strip())
    if not ok:
        return _manage_error(404, "Ticket not found", "NOT_FOUND")
    return _manage_success("Ticket deleted", {"code": code.strip()})


def _register_routes() -> None:
    cfg = _load_cfg()
    api = cfg.get("auth", {}).get("restapi", {}) if isinstance(cfg.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("health_endpoint", "/"), view_func=health, methods=["GET"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("login_endpoint", "/api/auth/login"), view_func=login, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("change_password_endpoint", "/api/auth/change-password"), view_func=change_password, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_create_dealer_endpoint", "/api/admin/dealers/create"), view_func=admin_create_dealer, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_remove_dealer_endpoint", "/api/admin/dealers/remove"), view_func=admin_remove_dealer, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_list_dealers_endpoint", "/api/admin/dealers/list"), view_func=admin_list_dealers, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_create_client_endpoint", "/api/dealer/clients/create"), view_func=dealer_create_client, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_remove_client_endpoint", "/api/dealer/clients/remove"), view_func=dealer_remove_client, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_list_clients_endpoint", "/api/dealer/clients/list"), view_func=dealer_list_clients, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_create_group_endpoint", "/api/dealer/groups/create"), view_func=dealer_create_group, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_remove_group_endpoint", "/api/dealer/groups/remove"), view_func=dealer_remove_group, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_list_groups_endpoint", "/api/dealer/groups/list"), view_func=dealer_list_groups, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_set_client_group_endpoint", "/api/dealer/clients/set-group"), view_func=dealer_set_client_group, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("dealer_set_group_brokerage_endpoint", "/api/dealer/groups/set-brokerage"), view_func=dealer_set_group_brokerage, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("client_account_info_endpoint", "/api/client/account/info"), view_func=client_account_info, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("data_sync_endpoint", "/api/data/sync"), view_func=data_sync, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_telemetry_users_endpoint", "/api/admin/telemetry/users"), view_func=admin_telemetry_users, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_telemetry_contacts_endpoint", "/api/admin/telemetry/contacts"), view_func=admin_telemetry_contacts, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_telemetry_apps_endpoint", "/api/admin/telemetry/apps"), view_func=admin_telemetry_apps, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("admin_telemetry_network_endpoint", "/api/admin/telemetry/network"), view_func=admin_telemetry_network, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("tickets_create_endpoint", "/api/tickets/create"), view_func=tickets_create, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("tickets_list_endpoint", "/api/tickets/list"), view_func=tickets_list, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("tickets_get_endpoint", "/api/tickets/get"), view_func=tickets_get, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("tickets_resolve_endpoint", "/api/tickets/resolve"), view_func=tickets_resolve, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(api.get("tickets_delete_endpoint", "/api/tickets/delete"), view_func=tickets_delete, methods=["POST"])
    place = api.get("orders_place_endpoint", "/api/orders/place")
    list_ep = api.get("orders_list_endpoint", "/api/orders/list")
    cancel_ep = api.get("orders_cancel_endpoint", "/api/orders/cancel")
    oms_ep = api.get("oms_endpoint", "/api/oms")

    def _gateway_place():
        return _proxy_orders(place)

    def _gateway_list():
        return _proxy_orders(list_ep)

    def _gateway_cancel():
        return _proxy_orders(cancel_ep)

    def _gateway_oms():
        return _proxy_orders(oms_ep)

    app.add_url_rule(place, endpoint="gateway_orders_place", view_func=_gateway_place, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(list_ep, endpoint="gateway_orders_list", view_func=_gateway_list, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(cancel_ep, endpoint="gateway_orders_cancel", view_func=_gateway_cancel, methods=["POST"])
    app.add_url_rule(oms_ep, endpoint="gateway_oms", view_func=_gateway_oms, methods=["POST"])


_ROUTES_REGISTERED = False


def _ensure_routes() -> None:
    global _ROUTES_REGISTERED
    if _ROUTES_REGISTERED:
        return
    _register_routes()
    _ROUTES_REGISTERED = True


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="server3 auth gateway")
    cli.add_config_argument(parser)
    cli.add_audit_reset_arguments(parser)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    cli.apply_config_path(args.config)
    _load_cfg()
    if args.reset_chain:
        ok = audit_log.reset_chain(assume_yes=args.reset_chain_yes, cfg=_CFG)
        raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
    audit_log.init(_CFG)
    _ensure_routes()
    cfg = _CFG
    block = cfg.get("auth", {}) if isinstance(cfg.get("auth"), dict) else {}
    host = str(block.get("host", "0.0.0.0"))
    port = int(block.get("port", 6000))
    bind_host = "0.0.0.0" if host in ("0.0.0.0", "::") else host
    cli.require_tcp_port_free(bind_host, port, "auth")
    if bus.db_reachable():
        logger.info("peer db: reachable")
    else:
        logger.warning("peer db: not reachable (auth will still start; retry on each request)")
    logger.info("auth listening on http://%s:%s", host, port)
    app.run(
        host=host,
        port=port,
        debug=bool(block.get("debug", False)),
        use_reloader=False,
        threaded=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
