def ep(api: Dict[str, str], key: str) -> str:
    return api.get(key, DEFAULT_API.get(key, "/"))


def dealer_username(dealer_id: str) -> str:
    did = dealer_id.strip()
    return did if did.startswith("dealer_") else f"dealer_{did}"


def default_group_id(dealer_id: str) -> str:
    return f"default__{dealer_id.strip()}"


def api_success(status: int, body: Any) -> bool:
    if not (200 <= status < 300):
        return False
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return True
    st = str(body.get("status", "")).lower()
    return st not in ("error", "failed", "rejected")


def api_error(status: int, body: Any) -> bool:
    """True when the API returned an explicit error (4xx or error status)."""
    if isinstance(body, dict):
        st = str(body.get("status", "")).lower()
        if st in ("error", "failed", "rejected"):
            return True
    return not (200 <= status < 300)


def error_code(body: Any) -> str:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return ""
    return str(body.get("error_code") or "").strip().upper()


def trading_metrics(body: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body, dict) else {}
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return {}
    tm = data.get("trading_metrics")
    return tm if isinstance(tm, dict) else {}


def http_json(
    method: str,
    url: str,
    body: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Tuple[int, Any]:
    """GET/POST JSON; returns (status_code, parsed_body)."""
    data = None
    headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
    if method.upper() != "GET":
        data = json.dumps(body if body is not None else {}).encode("utf-8")
        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
    req = Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method=method.upper())
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT_SEC) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            status = int(resp.status)
    except HTTPError as exc:
        status = int(exc.code)
        raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.fp else ""
    except URLError as exc:
        return 0, {"status": "error", "message": str(exc.reason)}
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        parsed = {"_raw": raw[:2000]}
    return status, parsed


@dataclass

@dataclass
class StepResult:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str = ""


# Default order symbol when marketdata streams crypto (override via E2E_EXCHANGE / E2E_SYMBOL).
DEFAULT_E2E_EXCHANGE = "LIGHTER_FO"
DEFAULT_E2E_SYMBOL = "BTC"


def _md_udp_block(cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Same resolution as lib.marketdata_udp: risk.marketdata_udp, else marketdata.udp."""
    risk = cfg.get("risk") if isinstance(cfg.get("risk"), dict) else {}
    md = risk.get("marketdata_udp") if isinstance(risk.get("marketdata_udp"), dict) else {}
    if md:
        return md
    mdc = cfg.get("marketdata") if isinstance(cfg.get("marketdata"), dict) else {}
    return mdc.get("udp", {}) if isinstance(mdc.get("udp"), dict) else {}


def send_md_tick_datagram(cfg: Dict[str, Any], raw: bytes) -> None:
    """Send one tick datagram (unicast or multicast). Stdlib-only for portable e2e_cli."""
    udp = _md_udp_block(cfg)
    ports = cfg.get("reserved_ports") if isinstance(cfg.get("reserved_ports"), dict) else {}
    port = int(udp.get("port", ports.get("marketdata_udp", 6003)))
    host = str(udp.get("host", "127.0.0.1"))
    mode = str(udp.get("mode", "")).strip().lower()
    if not mode:
        mode = "unicast" if bool(udp.get("broadcast", False)) else "multicast"
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        if mode == "multicast":
            group = str(udp.get("group", "239.255.0.3"))
            ttl = max(1, int(udp.get("ttl", 1)))
            iface = str(udp.get("interface", host))
            sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IP, socket.IP_MULTICAST_TTL, ttl)
            sock.setsockopt(
                socket.IPPROTO_IP,
                socket.IP_MULTICAST_LOOP,
                1 if bool(udp.get("loopback", True)) else 0,
            )
            try:
                sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IP, socket.IP_MULTICAST_IF, socket.inet_aton(iface))
            except OSError:
                pass
            sock.sendto(raw, (group, port))
        else:
            if bool(udp.get("broadcast", False)):
                sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_BROADCAST, 1)
            sock.sendto(raw, (host, port))
    finally:
        sock.close()


class E2ERunner:
    def __init__(
        self,
        sess: Session,
        api: Dict[str, str],
        verbose: bool = False,
        *,
        stop_on_fail: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.s = sess
        self.api = api
        self.verbose = verbose
        self.stop_on_fail = stop_on_fail
        self.results: List[StepResult] = []
        self._demo_user = ""
        self._demo_pass = ""
        self._demo_server = ""
        self._demo_initial_balance = 100000.0
        self._demo_seed_enabled = True
        self._cfg: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._oms_base = "http://127.0.0.1:6001"

    def _url(self, path: str) -> str:
        p = path if path.startswith("/") else "/" + path
        return self.s.base_url.rstrip("/") + p

    def _call(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        body: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        label: str = "",
    ) -> Tuple[int, Any]:
        label = label or f"{method} {path}"
        url = self._url(path)
        status, data = http_json(method, url, body)
        if self.verbose:
            print(f"\n--- {label} ---")
            print(f"URL: {url}")
            print(f"SENT: {json.dumps(body, indent=2) if body else '(none)'}")
            print(f"RECV [{status}]: {json.dumps(data, indent=2)}")
        return status, data

    def _record(self, name: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
        self.results.append(StepResult(name, ok, detail))
        mark = "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"
        line = f"  [{mark}] {name}"
        if detail:
            line += f" — {detail}"
        print(line)
        return ok

    def _step(self, name: str, fn: Callable[[], bool]) -> bool:
        try:
            ok = fn()
        except Exception as exc:
            ok = self._record(name, False, str(exc))
        if not ok and self.stop_on_fail:
            return False
        return ok

    def configure_demo_seed(self, cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        user, password, server, bal, enabled = seed_demo_from_config(cfg)
        self._demo_user = user
        self._demo_pass = password
        self._demo_server = server
        self._demo_initial_balance = bal
        self._demo_seed_enabled = enabled

    def configure_services(self, cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Load config for OMS internal calls, marketdata UDP, risk engine."""
        self._cfg = cfg
        self.configure_demo_seed(cfg)
        auth = cfg.get("auth") if isinstance(cfg.get("auth"), dict) else {}
        self._oms_base = str(auth.get("oms_internal_base", "http://127.0.0.1:6001")).rstrip("/")

    def _e2e_symbol(self) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        ex = os.environ.get("E2E_EXCHANGE", DEFAULT_E2E_EXCHANGE)
        sym = os.environ.get("E2E_SYMBOL", DEFAULT_E2E_SYMBOL)
        return ex, sym

    def _inject_tick(self, exchange: str, symbol: str, ltp: float, *, bid: float | None = None, ask: float | None = None) -> None:
        """Broadcast a synthetic tick on marketdata UDP (matching_engine + risk consume it)."""
        b = bid if bid is not None else ltp * 0.999
        a = ask if ask is not None else ltp * 1.001
        payload = {
            "EXCHANGE": exchange,
            "SYMBOL": symbol,
            "LTP": ltp,
            "BUY PRICE": b,
            "SELL PRICE": a,
            "HIGH": ltp * 1.01,
            "LOW": ltp * 0.99,
        }
        send_md_tick_datagram(self._cfg, json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"))

    def _risk_recompute(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        *,
        exchange: str | None = None,
        symbol: str | None = None,
        ltp: float = 50000.0,
        bid: float | None = None,
        ask: float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Recompute metrics; feed quotes into in-process RiskEngine (E2E test helper)."""
        from lib import config_loader
        from lib.risk.engine import get_risk_engine

        ex = exchange or self._e2e_symbol()[0]
        sym = symbol or self._e2e_symbol()[1]
        b = bid if bid is not None else ltp * 0.999
        a = ask if ask is not None else ltp * 1.001
        cfg = self._cfg if self._cfg else config_loader.load_config()
        engine = get_risk_engine(cfg)
        engine.on_tick(
            {
                "EXCHANGE": ex,
                "SYMBOL": sym,
                "LTP": ltp,
                "BUY PRICE": b,
                "SELL PRICE": a,
            }
        )
        engine.recompute_account(account_id)

    def _oms_call(self, path: str, body: Dict[str, Any], label: str = "") -> Tuple[int, Any]:
        url = self._oms_base.rstrip("/") + (path if path.startswith("/") else "/" + path)
        return http_json("POST", url, body)

    def _account_row(self, username: str, password: str, server: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        resp = self._db_call(
            "db.accounts.verify",
            {"username": username, "password": password, "server": server},
        )
        if resp.get("status") != "ok":
            return {}
        data = resp.get("data")
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

    def _seed_trade(
        self,
        account_id: int,
        username: str,
        *,
        dealer_id: str,
        group_id: str,
        exchange: str,
        symbol: str,
        side: str,
        qty: int,
        price: float,
    ) -> bool:
        trade_id = f"e2e_{secrets.token_hex(10)}"
        now = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
        trade = {
            "trade_id": trade_id,
            "order_id": f"ord_{trade_id}",
            "ticket_no": f"TKT_{trade_id[:8]}",
            "fill_id": f"fill_{trade_id[:8]}",
            "account_id": account_id,
            "dealer_id": dealer_id,
            "group_id": group_id,
            "username": username,
            "server": self.s.server,
            "deviceID": self.s.device_id,
            "macID": self.s.mac_id,
            "deviceIP": "127.0.0.1",
            "timestamp": now,
            "order_time": now,
            "symbol": symbol,
            "exchange": exchange,
            "order_type": side,
            "order_mode": "MARKET",
            "product_type": "INTRADAY",
            "validity": "DAY",
            "quantity": qty,
            "price": price,
            "reference_price": price,
            "market_fill_price": price,
            "status": "filled",
            "trade_json": {},
        }
        resp = self._db_call("db.trades.create", {"trade": trade})
        return resp.get("status") == "ok"

    def _metrics_row(self, account_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        resp = self._db_call("db.metrics.get_client", {"account_id": account_id})
        if resp.get("status") != "ok":
            return {}
        data = resp.get("data")
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

    def _db_call(self, msg_type: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        from lib import bus

        return bus.call(msg_type, payload, caller="e2e_test")

    def _account_id(self, username: str, password: str, server: str) -> int:
        resp = self._db_call(
            "db.accounts.verify",
            {"username": username, "password": password, "server": server},
        )
        if resp.get("status") != "ok":
            return 0
        data = resp.get("data") if isinstance(resp.get("data"), dict) else {}
        return int(data.get("id") or data.get("account_id") or 0)

    def _place_order_raw(
        self,
        user: str,
        password: str,
        *,
        exchange: str,
        symbol: str,
        qty: int,
        reference_price: float,
        side: str = "BUY",
        mode: str = "MARKET",
        price: float = 0.0,
        client_ticket: str = "",
    ) -> Tuple[int, Any]:
        ticket = client_ticket or f"TKT_{int(time.time())}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}"
        order_block: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "exchange": exchange,
            "symbol": symbol,
            "side": side,
            "mode": mode,
            "product": "INTRADAY",
            "validity": "DAY",
            "quantity": qty,
            "price": float(price),
            "reference_price": reference_price,
        }
        return self._call(
            "POST",
            ep(self.api, "orders_place_endpoint"),
            {
                "msg_type": "order_place_request",
                "credentials": self.s.creds(user, password),
                "client_ticket": ticket,
                "order": order_block,
            },

        )

    def _order_id_from_place(self, body: Any) -> str:
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            return ""
        data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
        return str(body.get("order_id") or data.get("order_id") or "").strip()

    def _order_status_from_place(self, body: Any) -> str:
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            return ""
        data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
        return str(
            body.get("order_status") or data.get("order_status") or ""
        ).strip().lower()

    def _margin_reserved_sum(self, account_id: int) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        resp = self._db_call("db.margin.sum_reserved", {"account_id": account_id})
        data = resp.get("data") if isinstance(resp.get("data"), dict) else {}
        return (
            float(data.get("reserved_margin", 0) or 0),
            float(data.get("reserved_notional", 0) or 0),
        )

    def _cancel_order_raw(
        self, user: str, password: str, order_id: str, client_ticket: str = ""
    ) -> Tuple[int, Any]:
        return self._call(

            {
                "msg_type": "order_cancel_request",
                "credentials": self.s.creds(user, password),
                "order_id": order_id,
                "client_ticket": client_ticket or f"TKT_cancel_{secrets.token_hex(4)}",
            },
            label="Cancel order",
        )

    def health(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            status, body = self._call("GET", ep(self.api, "health_endpoint"), label="Health")
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record("Health", False, f"HTTP {status}")
            peers = (body.get("data") or {}).get("peers", {})
            db_ok = bool(peers.get("db_udp"))
            oms_ok = bool(peers.get("oms_http"))
            if not (db_ok and oms_ok):
                return self._record("Health", False, f"db_udp={db_ok} oms_http={oms_ok}")
            return self._record("Health", True, "auth, db, oms up")

        return self._step("Health", run)

    def place_order(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Place order", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_tradable_normal(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Place order", False, "account not NORMAL")
            mark = 50000.0
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, mark)
            ticket = f"TKT_{int(time.time())}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}"
            status, body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "orders_place_endpoint"),
                {
                    "msg_type": "order_place_request",
                    "credentials": self.s.creds(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass),
                    "client_ticket": ticket,
                    "order": {
                        "exchange": exchange,
                        "symbol": symbol,
                        "side": "BUY",
                        "mode": "MARKET",
                        "product": "INTRADAY",
                        "validity": "DAY",
                        "quantity": 1,
                        "price": 0.0,
                        "reference_price": mark,
                    },
                },
                label="Place order",
            )
            data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
            ticket_out = str(body.get("client_ticket") or data.get("client_ticket", ""))
            if ticket_out:
                self.s.last_client_ticket = ticket_out
            ok = api_success(status, body)
            if ok:
                nested = data.get("order") if isinstance(data.get("order"), dict) else {}
                ok = (
                    data.get("deviceID") is not None
                    and "reference_price" in nested
                    and str(body.get("order_status", "")).lower() in ("filled", "pending", "rejected", "submitted")
                )
            return self._record("Place order", ok, ticket_out or str(body.get("message", "")))

        return self._step("Place order", run)

    def list_orders(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            status, body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "orders_list_endpoint"),
                {

                    "credentials": self.s.creds(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass),
                    "filters": {"status": "ALL", "limit": 50},

            orders = (body.get("data") or {}).get("orders", [])
            ok = api_success(status, body) and len(orders) >= 1
            if ok and orders:

                nested = row.get("order") if isinstance(row.get("order"), dict) else {}
                ok = (
                    "deviceID" in row
                    and "macID" in row
                    and "deviceIP" in row
                    and "order_status" in row
                    and "reference_price" in nested
                )
            return self._record("List orders", ok, f"count={len(orders)}")

        return self._step("List orders", run)

    def demo_client_funding(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            if not self._demo_seed_enabled:
                return self._record("Demo client funding", True, "seed disabled in config")
            status, body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "login_endpoint"),
                {
                    "msg_type": "login_request",
                    "credentials": self.s.creds(self._demo_user, self._demo_pass),
                },
                label="Demo client login",
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record("Demo client funding", False, "demo login failed")
            demo_server = self._demo_server or self.s.server
            status, body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "client_account_info_endpoint"),
                {
                    "auth": {
                        "username": self._demo_user,
                        "password": self._demo_pass,
                        "server": demo_server,
                        "deviceID": self.s.device_id,
                        "macID": self.s.mac_id,
                    }
                },
                label="Demo account info",
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record("Demo client funding", False, "account info failed")
            tm = trading_metrics(body)
            init_bal = float(tm.get("initial_balance") or 0)
            bal = float(tm.get("balance") or 0)
            risk_st = str((body.get("data") or {}).get("risk_state") or tm.get("risk_state") or "")
            min_bal = self._demo_initial_balance * 0.9
            ok = init_bal >= min_bal or bal >= min_bal
            detail = f"initial={init_bal:.0f} balance={bal:.0f} risk={risk_st}"
            if not ok:
                detail += " (start risk_service + marketdata)"
            return self._record("Demo client funding", ok, detail)

        return self._step("Demo client funding", run)

    def risk_stop_out_blocks_place(self) -> bool:
        """Real STOP_OUT (trades + crash mark); risk-increasing place must reject."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk STOP_OUT blocks place", False, "account_id lookup failed")
            if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk STOP_OUT blocks place", False, "could not flatten account")
            if not self._induce_stop_out(aid, row, self.s.client_user, exchange, symbol):
                return self._record("Risk STOP_OUT blocks place", False, "failed to reach STOP_OUT")
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=1000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0)
            m = self._metrics_row(aid)
            info_state = str(m.get("risk_state", ""))
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=1,
                reference_price=1000.0,
            )
            code = error_code(body)
            data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
            place_st = str(body.get("order_status", data.get("order_status", ""))).lower()
            blocked = (
                not api_success(status, body)
                or code == "MARGIN_STOP_OUT"
                or place_st == "rejected"
                or str(body.get("status", "")).lower() == "error"
            )
            ok = info_state == "STOP_OUT" and blocked
            self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            )
            return self._record(
                "Risk STOP_OUT blocks place",
                ok,
                f"info={info_state} http={status} code={code} order={place_st}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk STOP_OUT blocks place", run)

    def risk_stop_out_rejects_order(self) -> bool:
        """Alias for extended suite: new risk must be rejected when STOP_OUT."""
        return self.risk_stop_out_blocks_place()

    def risk_flat_blocked_rejects_order(self) -> bool:
        """Real FLAT_BLOCKED (flat + low equity); new BUY returns MARGIN_STOP_OUT."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk FLAT_BLOCKED rejects", False, "account_id lookup failed")
            if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk FLAT_BLOCKED rejects", False, "could not flatten account")
            if not self._induce_flat_blocked(aid, row, self.s.client_user, exchange, symbol):
                m = self._metrics_row(aid)
                return self._record(
                    "Risk FLAT_BLOCKED rejects",
                    False,
                    f"failed to reach FLAT_BLOCKED state={m.get('risk_state')}",
                )
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=1,
                reference_price=50000.0,
            )
            code = error_code(body)
            ok = api_error(status, body) and code == "MARGIN_STOP_OUT"
            return self._record(
                "Risk FLAT_BLOCKED rejects",
                ok,
                code or f"HTTP {status}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk FLAT_BLOCKED rejects", run)

    def risk_rapid_stack_blocks_fifth_buy(self) -> bool:
        """Reserved-margin ledger: burst BUYs exhaust free margin before 5th place."""
        def run() -> bool:
            if not self._demo_seed_enabled:
                return self._record("Risk rapid stack 5th blocked", True, "skipped (no demo seed)")
            user = self._demo_user
            password = self._demo_pass
            server = self._demo_server
            ib = self._demo_initial_balance
            aid = self._account_id(user, password, server)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk rapid stack 5th blocked", False, "demo account_id failed")
            mark = 76000.0
            self._db_call(
                "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
                {
                    "account_id": aid,
                    "initial_balance": ib,
                    "balance": ib,
                    "equity": ib,
                    "margin": 0.0,
                    "margin_free": ib,
                    "risk_state": "NORMAL",
                    "risk_reason": "",
                    "square_off_in_progress": False,
                },
            )
            self._inject_tick(DEFAULT_E2E_EXCHANGE, DEFAULT_E2E_SYMBOL, mark)
            time.sleep(0.2)
            blocked = 0
            filled = 0
            errors: List[str] = []
            for i in range(5):
                status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                    user,
                    password,
                    exchange=DEFAULT_E2E_EXCHANGE,
                    symbol=DEFAULT_E2E_SYMBOL,
                    qty=1,
                    reference_price=mark,
                    client_ticket=f"TKT_{int(time.time())}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}",
                )
                code = error_code(body)
                st = self._order_status_from_place(body)
                if code == "INSUFFICIENT_FREE_MARGIN":
                    blocked += 1
                    errors.append(f"{i}:403 {code}")
                elif api_success(status, body) and st == "filled":
                    filled += 1
                    errors.append(f"{i}:filled")
                elif api_error(status, body):
                    blocked += 1
                    errors.append(f"{i}:{code or 'error'}")
                else:
                    errors.append(f"{i}:HTTP{status} st={st}")
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=DEFAULT_E2E_EXCHANGE, symbol=DEFAULT_E2E_SYMBOL, ltp=mark)
            ok = blocked >= 1 and filled <= 4
            return self._record(
                "Risk rapid stack 5th blocked",
                ok,
                f"blocked={blocked} filled={filled} " + "; ".join(errors),
            )

        return self._step("Risk rapid stack 5th blocked", run)

    def risk_manual_flatten_clears_square_off(self) -> bool:
        """STOP_OUT + square-off latch; manual SELL to flat clears square_off_in_progress."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk manual flat clears sq", False, "no account_id")
            mark = 76000.0
            if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol, mark=mark
            ):
                return self._record("Risk manual flat clears sq", False, "could not flatten account")
            self._db_call(
                "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
                {"account_id": aid, "initial_balance": 30000.0},
            )
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=1,
                price=50000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Risk manual flat clears sq", False, "seed trade failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0)
            self._risk_recompute(
                aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=1000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0
            )
            m0 = self._metrics_row(aid)
            if str(m0.get("risk_state", "")) != "STOP_OUT":
                return self._record(
                    "Risk manual flat clears sq",
                    False,
                    f"expected STOP_OUT got {m0.get('risk_state')}",
                )
            # Stuck latch (open position + sq flag) — production failure mode; not a synthetic risk_state.
            self._db_call(
                "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
                {
                    "account_id": aid,
                    "square_off_in_progress": True,
                    "risk_state": "STOP_OUT",
                    "risk_reason": "E2E_SQ_STUCK",
                },
            )
            net = self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)
            if abs(net) < 1:
                return self._record("Risk manual flat clears sq", False, "no open position")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, mark)
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=abs(net),
                reference_price=mark,
                side="SELL",
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record(
                    "Risk manual flat clears sq",
                    False,
                    error_code(body) or str(body.get("message", "")),
                )
            time.sleep(1.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=mark)
            m = self._metrics_row(aid)
            sq_flag = bool(m.get("square_off_in_progress", False))
            state = str(m.get("risk_state", ""))
            flat = abs(self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)) < 1
            ok = flat and not sq_flag
            return self._record(
                "Risk manual flat clears sq",
                ok,
                f"state={state} sq_progress={sq_flag} flat={flat}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk manual flat clears sq", run)

    def risk_reduce_only_during_stop_out(self) -> bool:
        """STOP_OUT: SELL close allowed, BUY rejected."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk reduce-only STOP_OUT", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk reduce-only STOP_OUT", False, "could not flatten account")
            if not self._induce_stop_out(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, exchange, symbol, qty=3, entry=50000.0
            ):
                return self._record("Risk reduce-only STOP_OUT", False, "failed to reach STOP_OUT")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0)
            self._risk_recompute(
                aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=1000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0
            )
            st_sell, body_sell = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=1,
                reference_price=50000.0,
                side="SELL",
            )
            st_buy, body_buy = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=1,
                reference_price=50000.0,
                side="BUY",
            )
            sell_ok = api_success(st_sell, body_sell)
            buy_code = error_code(body_buy)
            buy_blocked = (
                api_error(st_buy, body_buy)
                and buy_code in ("MARGIN_STOP_OUT", "INSUFFICIENT_FREE_MARGIN")
            ) or str(body_buy.get("order_status", "")).lower() == "rejected"
            ok = sell_ok and buy_blocked
            return self._record(
                "Risk reduce-only STOP_OUT",
                ok,
                f"sell_ok={sell_ok} buy_code={buy_code}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk reduce-only STOP_OUT", run)

    def risk_cancel_releases_reservation(self) -> bool:
        """Pending RL cancel → margin_reservations row removed."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk cancel releases reserve", False, "account_id failed")
            if not self._ensure_tradable_normal(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk cancel releases reserve", False, "account not NORMAL")
            mark = 50000.0
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, mark)
            ticket = f"TKT_{int(time.time())}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}"
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=1,
                reference_price=mark,
                mode="RL",
                price=mark,
                client_ticket=ticket,
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record(
                    "Risk cancel releases reserve",
                    False,
                    error_code(body) or "RL place failed",
                )
            order_id = self._order_id_from_place(body)
            place_st = self._order_status_from_place(body)
            reserved_before, _ = self._margin_reserved_sum(aid)
            if place_st not in ("pending", "placed", "delayed") and reserved_before <= 0:
                return self._record(
                    "Risk cancel releases reserve",
                    True,
                    f"skipped (immediate {place_st}, no reservation)",
                )
            if not order_id:
                return self._record("Risk cancel releases reserve", False, "no order_id")
            if reserved_before <= 0:
                time.sleep(0.3)
                reserved_before, _ = self._margin_reserved_sum(aid)
            c_status, c_body = self._cancel_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, order_id, ticket
            )
            reserved_after, _ = self._margin_reserved_sum(aid)
            cancel_ok = api_success(c_status, c_body) or str(
                c_body.get("order_status", "")
            ).lower() == "cancelled"
            ok = cancel_ok and reserved_after <= 0.001
            self._reset_ephemeral_risk_normal(aid)
            return self._record(
                "Risk cancel releases reserve",
                ok,
                f"before={reserved_before:.2f} after={reserved_after:.2f} cancel={cancel_ok}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk cancel releases reserve", run)

    def risk_warning_state_after_tight_margin(self) -> bool:
        """Large long → recompute → WARNING (LOW_FREE_MARGIN) while still tradable."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk WARNING state", False, "account_id failed")
            if not self._ensure_tradable_normal(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk WARNING state", False, "account not NORMAL")
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=5,
                price=50000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Risk WARNING state", False, "seed failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=50000.0)
            m = self._metrics_row(aid)
            state = str(m.get("risk_state", ""))
            margin_free = float(m.get("margin_free", 0) or 0)
            equity = float(m.get("equity", 0) or 0)
            ok = state == "WARNING" and equity > 0 and margin_free < equity * 0.25
            return self._record(
                "Risk WARNING state",
                ok,
                f"state={state} free={margin_free:.0f} equity={equity:.0f}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk WARNING state", run)

    def _clear_risk_client_trades_block(self, aid: int) -> None:
        """Best-effort: ensure risk client can trade again after STOP_OUT tests."""
        self._reset_ephemeral_risk_normal(aid)

    def account_info_has_risk_fields(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            status, body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "client_account_info_endpoint"),
                self.s.auth_block(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass),
                label="Account info risk fields",
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record("Account info risk fields", False, "request failed")
            data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
            tm = trading_metrics(body)
            ok = (
                "risk_state" in data
                and "margin_mode" in data
                and "leverage" in data
                and "risk_state" in tm
                and "margin_free" in tm
            )
            detail = (
                f"state={data.get('risk_state')} mode={data.get('margin_mode')} "
                f"lev={data.get('leverage')}"
            )
            return self._record("Account info risk fields", ok, detail)

        return self._step("Account info risk fields", run)

    # --- Pending / advanced E2E (fills, square-off, ME, recovery) ---

    def services_db_and_oms_health(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            db_resp = self._db_call("db.health", {})
            db_ok = db_resp.get("status") == "ok"
            status, body = http_json("GET", f"{self._oms_base}/", None)
            oms_ok = api_success(status, body)
            ok = db_ok and oms_ok
            return self._record(
                "DB + OMS health",
                ok,
                f"db={db_ok} oms={oms_ok} HTTP {status}",
            )

        return self._step("DB + OMS health", run)

    def market_fill_with_tick(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Market fill with tick", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_tradable_normal(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Market fill with tick", False, "account not NORMAL")
            mark = 50000.0
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, mark)
            time.sleep(0.3)
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=1,
                reference_price=mark,
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record("Market fill with tick", False, str(body.get("message", "")))
            order_st = str(body.get("order_status", "")).lower()
            data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
            order_st = order_st or str(data.get("order_status", "")).lower()
            reason = str(data.get("reason", ""))
            # Allow async fills: pending then poll list
            if order_st in ("pending", "placed"):
                time.sleep(2.5)
                _, list_body = self._call(
                    "POST",
                    ep(self.api, "orders_list_endpoint"),
                    {
                        "msg_type": "order_list_request",
                        "credentials": self.s.creds(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass),
                        "filters": {"status": "ALL", "limit": 5},
                    },
                    label="Poll orders after place",
                )
                orders = (list_body.get("data") or {}).get("orders", [])
                if orders:
                    order_st = str(orders[0].get("order_status", "")).lower()
                    reason = str(orders[0].get("reason", reason))
            ok = order_st == "filled"
            return self._record("Market fill with tick", ok, f"status={order_st} reason={reason}")

        return self._step("Market fill with tick", run)

    def leverage_limit_with_position(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Leverage limit", False, "no account_id")
            self._reset_ephemeral_risk_normal(aid)
            self._db_call(
                "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
                {
                    "account_id": aid,
                    "initial_balance": 100000.0,
                    "balance": 100000.0,
                    "equity": 100000.0,
                    "risk_state": "NORMAL",
                    "risk_reason": "",
                },
            )
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=6,
                price=50000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Leverage limit", False, "seed trade failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=50000.0)
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=25,
                reference_price=5000.0,
            )
            code = error_code(body)
            data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
            place_st = str(body.get("order_status", data.get("order_status", ""))).lower()
            reason = str(data.get("reason", data.get("reason", "")))
            ok = (
                (api_error(status, body) and code in (
                    "LEVERAGE_LIMIT",
                    "MARGIN_STOP_OUT",
                    "INSUFFICIENT_FREE_MARGIN",
                ))
                or (place_st == "rejected" and ("LEVERAGE" in reason.upper() or code))
                or code in ("LEVERAGE_LIMIT", "INSUFFICIENT_FREE_MARGIN")
            )
            detail = code or reason or str(body.get("message", "")) or f"HTTP {status} st={place_st}"
            return self._record("Leverage limit", ok, detail)

        return self._step("Leverage limit", run)

    def _reset_ephemeral_risk_normal(self, aid: int) -> None:
        self._db_call(
            "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
            {
                "account_id": aid,
                "initial_balance": 100000.0,
                "balance": 100000.0,
                "equity": 100000.0,
                "margin": 0.0,
                "margin_free": 100000.0,
                "risk_state": "NORMAL",
                "risk_reason": "",
                "square_off_in_progress": False,
            },
        )

    def _net_position_qty(self, account_id: int, exchange: str, symbol: str) -> int:
        """Net signed qty from tradebook (positive = long)."""
        resp = self._db_call(
            "db.trades.list",
            {"account_id": account_id, "limit": 500, "order": "ASC"},
        )
        data = resp.get("data") if isinstance(resp.get("data"), dict) else {}
        trades = data.get("tradebook", data.get("trades", []))
        if not isinstance(trades, list):
            return 0
        ex = exchange.strip().upper()
        sym = symbol.strip()
        net = 0.0
        for t in trades:
            if str(t.get("exchange", "")).strip().upper() != ex:
                continue
            if str(t.get("symbol", "")).strip() != sym:
                continue
            side = str(t.get("order_type", t.get("side", ""))).strip().upper()
            qty = int(t.get("quantity", 0) or 0)
            if qty < 1:
                continue
            if side == "BUY":
                net += qty
            elif side == "SELL":
                net -= qty
        return int(round(net))

    def _cancel_pending_orders(self, user: str, password: str) -> None:
        _, body = self._call(
            "POST",
            ep(self.api, "orders_list_endpoint"),
            {
                "msg_type": "order_list_request",
                "credentials": self.s.creds(user, password),
                "filters": {"status": "ALL", "limit": 50},
            },
            label="List orders for cancel",
        )
        orders = (body.get("data") or {}).get("orders", [])
        if not isinstance(orders, list):
            return
        for row in orders:
            st = str(row.get("order_status", "")).lower()
            if st not in ("pending", "placed", "delayed"):
                continue
            oid = str(row.get("order_id", ""))
            ticket = str(row.get("client_ticket", ""))
            if oid:
                self._cancel_order_raw(user, password, oid, ticket)

    def _ensure_flat_normal_trading(
        self,
        aid: int,
        user: str,
        password: str,
        exchange: str,
        symbol: str,
        *,
        mark: float = 50000.0,
    ) -> bool:
        """Close positions and pending orders via real API; recompute until flat."""
        self._cancel_pending_orders(user, password)
        net = self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)
        if abs(net) >= 1:
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, mark)
            side = "SELL" if net > 0 else "BUY"
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                user,
                password,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=abs(net),
                reference_price=mark,
                side=side,
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return False
            time.sleep(1.0)
        self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, mark)
        self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=mark)
        m = self._metrics_row(aid)
        state = str(m.get("risk_state", ""))
        sq = bool(m.get("square_off_in_progress", False))
        net_after = self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)
        if abs(net_after) < 1 and sq:
            self._db_call(
                "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
                {"account_id": aid, "square_off_in_progress": False},
            )
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=mark)
            sq = bool(self._metrics_row(aid).get("square_off_in_progress", False))
        return abs(net_after) < 1 and not sq and state in ("NORMAL", "WARNING", "FLAT_BLOCKED")

    def _induce_stop_out(
        self,
        aid: int,
        row: Dict[str, Any],
        user: str,
        exchange: str,
        symbol: str,
        *,
        qty: int = 1,
        entry: float = 50000.0,
    ) -> bool:
        """Real STOP_OUT: seed long + crash mark + risk recompute."""
        if not self._seed_trade(
            aid,
            user,
            dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
            group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
            exchange=exchange,
            symbol=symbol,
            side="BUY",
            qty=qty,
            price=entry,
        ):
            return False
        self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, entry, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0)
        self._risk_recompute(
            aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=1000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0
        )
        m = self._metrics_row(aid)
        return str(m.get("risk_state", "")) == "STOP_OUT"

    def _induce_flat_blocked(
        self,
        aid: int,
        row: Dict[str, Any],
        user: str,
        exchange: str,
        symbol: str,
        *,
        qty: int = 1,
        entry: float = 50000.0,
        exit_px: float = 1000.0,
        initial_balance: float = 20000.0,
    ) -> bool:
        """Real FLAT_BLOCKED: stop-out, close at crash price, flat with low equity."""
        self._db_call(
            "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
            {"account_id": aid, "initial_balance": initial_balance},
        )
        if not self._induce_stop_out(
            aid, row, user, exchange, symbol, qty=qty, entry=entry
        ):
            return False
        if not self._seed_trade(
            aid,
            user,
            dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
            group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
            exchange=exchange,
            symbol=symbol,
            side="SELL",
            qty=qty,
            price=exit_px,
        ):
            return False
        self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, exit_px)
        self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=exit_px)
        m = self._metrics_row(aid)
        return (
            str(m.get("risk_state", "")) == "FLAT_BLOCKED"
            and abs(self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)) < 1
        )

    def _ensure_tradable_normal(
        self,
        aid: int,
        row: Dict[str, Any],
        user: str,
        password: str,
        exchange: str,
        symbol: str,
    ) -> bool:
        """Flat book and risk_state NORMAL (recovery seeds if post-loss FLAT_BLOCKED)."""
        if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(aid, user, password, exchange, symbol):
            return False
        m = self._metrics_row(aid)
        if str(m.get("risk_state", "")) == "NORMAL":
            return True
        if str(m.get("risk_state", "")) != "FLAT_BLOCKED":
            return False
        if abs(self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)) >= 1:
            return False
        if not self._seed_trade(
            aid,
            user,
            dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
            group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
            exchange=exchange,
            symbol=symbol,
            side="BUY",
            qty=1,
            price=10000.0,
        ):
            return False
        if not self._seed_trade(
            aid,
            user,
            dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
            group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
            exchange=exchange,
            symbol=symbol,
            side="SELL",
            qty=1,
            price=80000.0,
        ):
            return False
        self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 80000.0)
        self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=80000.0)
        return str(self._metrics_row(aid).get("risk_state", "")) == "NORMAL"

    def reduce_only_order_allowed(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or row.get("account_id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Reduce-only allowed", False, "no account_id")
            self._reset_ephemeral_risk_normal(aid)
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=3,
                price=50000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Reduce-only allowed", False, "seed trade failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid)
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                qty=3,
                reference_price=50000.0,
                side="SELL",
            )
            ok = api_success(status, body)
            return self._record("Reduce-only allowed", ok, str(body.get("order_status", error_code(body))))

        return self._step("Reduce-only allowed", run)

    def risk_metrics_after_trade(self) -> bool:
        """After a seeded fill + tick, margin and equity must be non-zero in DB metrics."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk metrics after trade", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_tradable_normal(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk metrics after trade", False, "account not NORMAL")
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=1,
                price=50000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Risk metrics after trade", False, "seed trade failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=50000.0)
            m = self._metrics_row(aid)
            margin = float(m.get("margin") or 0)
            equity = float(m.get("equity") or 0)
            ok = margin > 0 and equity > 0 and str(m.get("risk_state", "")) == "NORMAL"
            return self._record(
                "Risk metrics after trade",
                ok,
                f"margin={margin:.0f} equity={equity:.0f} state={m.get('risk_state')}",
            )

        return self._step("Risk metrics after trade", run)

    def risk_recovery_to_normal(self) -> bool:
        """FLAT_BLOCKED from real loss, then profitable flat trades → NORMAL on recompute."""
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Risk recovery NORMAL", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Risk recovery NORMAL", False, "could not flatten account")
            if not self._induce_flat_blocked(aid, row, self.s.client_user, exchange, symbol):
                return self._record("Risk recovery NORMAL", False, "failed to reach FLAT_BLOCKED")
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=1,
                price=10000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Risk recovery NORMAL", False, "recovery buy seed failed")
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="SELL",
                qty=1,
                price=80000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Risk recovery NORMAL", False, "recovery sell seed failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 80000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=80000.0)
            m = self._metrics_row(aid)
            state = str(m.get("risk_state", ""))
            ok = state == "NORMAL" and abs(self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)) < 1
            return self._record("Risk recovery NORMAL", ok, f"state={state}")

        return self._step("Risk recovery NORMAL", run)

    def square_off_flattens_position(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("Square-off flatten", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_flat_normal_trading(
                aid, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("Square-off flatten", False, "could not flatten account")
            self._db_call(
                "db.metrics.update_snapshot",
                {"account_id": aid, "initial_balance": 30000.0},
            )
            if not self._seed_trade(
                aid,
                self.s.client_user,
                dealer_id=str(row.get("dealer_id", self.s.dealer_id)),
                group_id=str(row.get("group_id", default_group_id(self.s.dealer_id))),
                exchange=exchange,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="BUY",
                qty=1,
                price=50000.0,
            ):
                return self._record("Square-off flatten", False, "seed trade failed")
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=50000.0)
            # Crash mark → stop-out on 1 BTC long (deep loss vs 30k equity)
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=1000.0, bid=1000.0, ask=1100.0)
            m_before = self._metrics_row(aid)
            st0 = str(m_before.get("risk_state", ""))
            if st0 != "STOP_OUT":
                return self._record("Square-off flatten", False, f"expected STOP_OUT got {st0}")
            # Fresh tick so ME can fill square-off MARKET legs
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            status, body = self._oms_call(
                "/internal/risk/square-off",
                {"account_id": aid},
                label="Internal square-off",
            )
            if not api_success(status, body):
                return self._record("Square-off flatten", False, f"square-off HTTP {status}")
            time.sleep(3.5)
            self._inject_tick(exchange, symbol, 50000.0)
            self._risk_recompute(aid, exchange=exchange, symbol=symbol, ltp=50000.0)
            _, list_body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "orders_list_endpoint"),
                {
                    "msg_type": "order_list_request",
                    "credentials": self.s.creds(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass),
                    "filters": {"status": "ALL", "limit": 50},
                },
                label="List orders after square-off",
            )
            orders = (list_body.get("data") or {}).get("orders", [])
            sq_orders = [
                o
                for o in orders
                if str(o.get("client_ticket", "")).startswith("SQOFF_")
            ]
            trades_resp = self._db_call("db.trades.list", {"account_id": aid, "order": "ASC"})
            data = trades_resp.get("data") if isinstance(trades_resp.get("data"), dict) else {}
            trades = data.get("tradebook", data.get("trades", []))
            sells = [
                t
                for t in trades
                if str(t.get("order_type", t.get("side", ""))).upper() == "SELL"
                and str(t.get("symbol", "")) == symbol
            ]
            m_after = self._metrics_row(aid)
            sq_flag = bool(m_after.get("square_off_in_progress", False))
            sq_filled = any(
                str(o.get("order_status", "")).lower() == "filled" for o in sq_orders
            )
            flat = abs(self._net_position_qty(aid, exchange, symbol)) < 1
            flattened = flat or len(sells) >= 1 or sq_filled
            ok = (
                st0 == "STOP_OUT"
                and api_success(status, body)
                and not sq_flag
                and flattened
            )
            detail = f"pre={st0} sells={len(sells)} sq_orders={len(sq_orders)} filled={sq_filled} sq_progress={sq_flag}"
            return self._record("Square-off flatten", ok, detail)

        return self._step("Square-off flatten", run)

    def rl_missing_price_rejected(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            ticket = f"TKT_{int(time.time())}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}"
            status, body = self._call(
                "POST",
                ep(self.api, "orders_place_endpoint"),
                {
                    "msg_type": "order_place_request",
                    "credentials": self.s.creds(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass),
                    "client_ticket": ticket,
                    "order": {
                        "exchange": exchange,
                        "symbol": symbol,
                        "side": "BUY",
                        "mode": "RL",
                        "product": "INTRADAY",
                        "validity": "DAY",
                        "quantity": 1,
                        "price": 0.0,
                        "reference_price": 0.0,
                    },
                },
                label="RL missing price",
            )
            ok = api_error(status, body)
            return self._record("RL missing price", ok, error_code(body) or f"HTTP {status}")

        return self._step("RL missing price", run)

    def no_market_data_unknown_symbol(self) -> bool:
        def run() -> bool:
            exchange, symbol = self._e2e_symbol()
            row = self._account_row(self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, self.s.server)
            aid = int(row.get("id") or 0)
            if aid < 1:
                return self._record("No market data", False, "no account_id")
            if not self._ensure_tradable_normal(
                aid, row, self.s.client_user, self.s.client_pass, exchange, symbol
            ):
                return self._record("No market data", False, "account not NORMAL")
            status, body = self._place_order_raw(
                self.s.client_user,
                self.s.client_pass,
                exchange=DEFAULT_E2E_EXCHANGE,
                symbol="E2E_NO_TICK_XYZ",
                qty=1,
                reference_price=1.0,
            )
            if status == 0:
                return self._record("No market data", False, "connection error")
            if not api_success(status, body) and error_code(body) not in ("NO_MARKET_DATA",):
                return self._record("No market data", False, f"HTTP {status} {error_code(body)}")
            data = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else {}
            reason = str(data.get("reason", ""))
            order_st = str(body.get("order_status", data.get("order_status", ""))).lower()
            ok = order_st == "rejected" and reason == "NO_MARKET_DATA"
            return self._record("No market data", ok, f"status={order_st} reason={reason}")

        return self._step("No market data", run)

    def run_all(self, cleanup: bool = True) -> bool:
        steps: List[Callable[[], bool]] = [
            self.health,
            self.admin_login,
            self.admin_create_dealer,
            self.admin_list_dealers,
            self.dealer_login,
            self.dealer_create_group,
            self.dealer_list_groups,
            self.dealer_set_brokerage,
            self.dealer_create_client,
            self.dealer_list_clients,
            self.dealer_set_client_group,
            self.client_login,
            self.client_account_info,
            self.place_order,
            self.list_orders,
        ]
        if cleanup:
            steps.extend([self.dealer_remove_client, self.dealer_remove_group, self.admin_remove_dealer])
        return self._run_steps(steps)

    def run_extended(self, cleanup: bool = True) -> bool:
        """Smoke + auth/RMS edge cases (no fill/square-off)."""
        steps: List[Callable[[], bool]] = [
            self.health,
            self.admin_login,
            self.invalid_admin_password,
            self.demo_client_funding,
            self.admin_create_dealer,
            self.admin_list_dealers,
            self.dealer_login,
            self.dealer_create_group,
            self.dealer_list_groups,
            self.dealer_set_brokerage,
            self.dealer_create_client,
            self.dealer_list_clients,
            self.dealer_set_client_group,
            self.client_login,
            self.account_info_has_risk_fields,
            self.client_account_info,
            self.demo_insufficient_free_margin,
            self.ephemeral_insufficient_margin,
            self.place_order_wrong_password,
            self.risk_flat_blocked_rejects_order,
            self.risk_stop_out_rejects_order,
            self.place_order,
            self.list_orders,
            self.client_calls_admin_api,
        ]
        if cleanup:
            steps.extend([self.dealer_remove_client, self.dealer_remove_group, self.admin_remove_dealer])
        return self._run_steps(steps)

    def run_risk(self, cleanup: bool = True) -> bool:
        """Reserved-margin ledger + risk state edge cases (needs full stack)."""
        steps: List[Callable[[], bool]] = [
            self.health,
            self.services_db_and_oms_health,
            self.admin_login,
            self.admin_create_dealer,
            self.dealer_login,
            self.dealer_create_group,
            self.dealer_create_client,
            self.client_login,
            self.account_info_has_risk_fields,
            self.risk_flat_blocked_rejects_order,
            self.risk_stop_out_blocks_place,
            self.risk_reduce_only_during_stop_out,
            self.risk_manual_flatten_clears_square_off,
            self.risk_cancel_releases_reservation,
            self.risk_rapid_stack_blocks_fifth_buy,
            self.risk_warning_state_after_tight_margin,
            self.risk_recovery_to_normal,
            self.reduce_only_order_allowed,
            self.square_off_flattens_position,
        ]
        if cleanup:
            steps.extend([self.dealer_remove_client, self.dealer_remove_group, self.admin_remove_dealer])
        return self._run_steps(steps)

    def run_full(self, cleanup: bool = True) -> bool:
        """Extended suite plus fills, square-off, WARNING/recovery, ME/order edge cases."""
        steps: List[Callable[[], bool]] = [
            self.health,
            self.services_db_and_oms_health,
            self.admin_login,
            self.invalid_admin_password,
            self.demo_client_funding,
            self.admin_create_dealer,
            self.admin_list_dealers,
            self.dealer_login,
            self.dealer_create_group,
            self.dealer_list_groups,
            self.dealer_set_brokerage,
            self.dealer_create_client,
            self.dealer_list_clients,
            self.dealer_set_client_group,
            self.client_login,
            self.create_risk_isolation_client,
            self.client_risk_login,
            self.risk_recovery_to_normal,
            self.reduce_only_order_allowed,
            self.square_off_flattens_position,
            self.account_info_has_risk_fields,
            self.client_account_info,
            self.demo_insufficient_free_margin,
            self.ephemeral_insufficient_margin,
            self.place_order_wrong_password,
            self.risk_flat_blocked_rejects_order,
            self.risk_stop_out_blocks_place,
            self.risk_reduce_only_during_stop_out,
            self.risk_manual_flatten_clears_square_off,
            self.risk_cancel_releases_reservation,
            self.risk_rapid_stack_blocks_fifth_buy,
            self.risk_warning_state_after_tight_margin,
            self.risk_metrics_after_trade,
            self.leverage_limit_with_position,
            self.market_fill_with_tick,
            self.rl_missing_price_rejected,
            self.no_market_data_unknown_symbol,
            self.place_order,
            self.list_orders,
            self.client_calls_admin_api,
        ]
        if cleanup:
            steps.extend([self.dealer_remove_client, self.dealer_remove_group, self.admin_remove_dealer])
        return self._run_steps(steps)

    def _run_steps(self, steps: List[Callable[[], bool]]) -> bool:
        all_ok = True
        for step_fn in steps:
            if not step_fn():
                all_ok = False
                if self.stop_on_fail:
                    break
            time.sleep(0.15)
        return all_ok


def run_unit_tests(verbose: bool = False) -> int:
    """Run stdlib unittest suite under tests/unit (no services required)."""
    import unittest

    loader = unittest.TestLoader()
    start_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "tests", "unit")
    suite = loader.discover(start_dir, pattern="test_*.py")
    runner = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2 if verbose else 1)
    result = runner.run(suite)
    print()
    print(f"Unit tests: {result.testsRun} run, {len(result.failures)} failed, {len(result.errors)} errors")
    return 0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1


def run_e2e_suite(
    *,
    base_url: str,
    cfg: Dict[str, Any],
    suite: str,
    verbose: bool,
    no_cleanup: bool,
    continue_on_fail: bool,
    admin_user: str,
    admin_pass: str,
    server: str,
) -> int:
    api = api_paths_from_config(cfg)
    base = base_url.strip() or auth_base_from_config(cfg)
    au, ap, srv = seed_admin_from_config(cfg)
    if admin_user.strip():
        au = admin_user.strip()
    if admin_pass.strip():
        ap = admin_pass.strip()
    if server.strip():
        srv = server.strip()

    sess = Session(base_url=base, server=srv, admin_user=au, admin_pass=ap)
    runner = E2ERunner(sess, api, verbose=verbose, stop_on_fail=not continue_on_fail)
    runner.configure_services(cfg)

    print("server3 E2E")
    print(f"  base:   {base}")
    print(f"  suite:  {suite}")
    print(f"  oms:    {runner._oms_base}")
    print(f"  suffix: {sess.suffix}")
    print(f"  dealer: {sess.dealer_user}")
    print(f"  client: {sess.client_user}")
    if runner._demo_seed_enabled:
        print(f"  demo:   {runner._demo_user} @ {runner._demo_server}")
    print()

    if suite == "smoke":
        ok = runner.run_all(cleanup=not no_cleanup)
    elif suite == "extended":
        ok = runner.run_extended(cleanup=not no_cleanup)
    elif suite == "risk":
        ok = runner.run_risk(cleanup=not no_cleanup)
    else:
        ok = runner.run_full(cleanup=not no_cleanup)

    passed = sum(1 for r in runner.results if r.ok)
    total = len(runner.results)
    print()
    print(f"Result: {passed}/{total} passed")
    if not ok:
        failed = [r.name for r in runner.results if not r.ok]
        print(f"Failed: {', '.join(failed)}")
        return 1
    print("All steps passed.")
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Standalone server3 E2E tests (stdlib only, single file)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--base-url",
        default="http://127.0.0.1:6000",
        help="Auth gateway URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:6000)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        default="",
        metavar="PATH",
        help="Optional config.json for URL paths and seed admin (not required)",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--admin-user", default="", help="Admin username (default admin1)")
    parser.add_argument("--admin-pass", default="", help="Admin password")
    parser.add_argument("--server", default="", help="Server name (default alex)")
    parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", help="Print SENT/RECV JSON")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--suite",
        choices=["unit", "smoke", "extended", "full", "risk", "all"],
        default="full",
        help="unit|smoke|extended|full|risk|all (all = unit then full E2E)",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--no-cleanup", action="store_true", help="Skip remove client/group/dealer")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--continue",
        dest="continue_on_fail",
        action="store_true",
        help="Run all steps even after a failure",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if args.config.strip():
        cfg = load_config_file(args.config.strip())
    else:
        cfg = load_config_file("config.json")

    if args.suite == "unit":
        sys.exit(run_unit_tests(verbose=args.verbose))
    if args.suite == "all":
        code = run_unit_tests(verbose=args.verbose)
        if code != 0:
            sys.exit(code)
        print("\n--- E2E (full) ---\n")
    suite = "full" if args.suite == "all" else args.suite
    sys.exit(
        run_e2e_suite(
            base_url=args.base_url,
            cfg=cfg,
            suite=suite,
            verbose=args.verbose,
            no_cleanup=args.no_cleanup,
            continue_on_fail=args.continue_on_fail,
            admin_user=args.admin_user,
            admin_pass=args.admin_pass,
            server=args.server,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
